samples: This program reads the command-line arguments, keeps only the ones that can be parsed as floating-point numbers, and prints the mean, median, and population standard deviation of those numbers. If an argument is not numeric, it reports that it is being skipped instead of stopping. If there are no valid numbers, each statistic is reported as “no data.”

This program reads the command-line arguments, keeps only those that can be parsed as floating-point numbers, and prints the mean, median, and population standard deviation of the valid numbers. If an argument is not numeric, it reports that it is being skipped instead of stopping. For empty input or any statistic that cannot be computed, it prints “no data.”
